definitions.explanation: The number 30,000, formed as {三|さん} (three) × {万|まん} (10,000). No sound change occurs — both parts keep their usual readings.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧{三万|さんまん}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧だ。
examples.english: This town has a population of about thirty thousand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{三万|さんまん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧になった。
examples.english: I bought a used bicycle for thirty thousand yen, but it soon needed repairs.

notes:
Japanese groups large numbers in units of 10,000 (⟦{万|まん}→万：00795_man⟧), so 30,000 is "three ⟦{万|まん}→万：00795_man⟧" rather than "thirty thousand".

COUNTING IN {万|まん}:
- ⟦{一万|いちまん}→一万：27599_ichiman⟧: 10,000 — note ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ is required; ⟦{万|まん}→万：00795_man⟧ alone is not used for 10,000
- ⟦{二万|にまん}→二万：23632_niman⟧: 20,000
- {三万|さんまん}: 30,000
- ⟦{十万|じゅうまん}→十万：30469_juuman⟧: 100,000

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {三万|さんまん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: thirty thousand yen
- {三万|さんまん}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧: thirty thousand people
- {三万|さんまん}⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧: thirty thousand cases or items
